fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that a grey auto bearing registration number TN-28-ZZ-1092 used by the complainant for daily work was taken from Palar Layout Market Road. The matter was brought to Karur Town PS on 2026-01-12, while the incident was placed on 2026-01-12 around 06:25 hrs. Anand Chandran approached Karur Town PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000060. The complainant could not identify the person involved. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly driven away after being left unattended.
fields.Keywords: auto theft, vehicle, auto, vehicle observation, early morning, market road, CCTV
